GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 3l off, improved 3 Wide turn, joined in Straightening Up , joint lead 200m, headed approaching 100m, kept on ok late without threatening # did enough

Away well. Pushed fwd & raced 2nd Two Wide (1L from lead). Stayed 2nd Two Wide midrace until pushed to quicken =lead Two Wide @ 650m. Pushed along Two Wide @ 500m & =lead 3 Wide on home turn. Pressured & challenged @ 250m & fought on in 2-horse battle in last 200m. Got the bob on line. # On-pace/got the bob
Jumped Well , Settled Down Two Wide 7th 5 Lengths @ 1200m. Off Mid-Field rail To The Turn . Gradually Gave Ground # never any threat

Jumped Ok , enjoyed good trail Two Wide With Cover behind speed 3 Lengths 1000m, came 3 Wide and challenged Leaders Straightening Up , had a tussle last 150m but Just found one better on line # just missed
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover until passing the 1500m crossing.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bumped @ start. Not pushed early & raced keenly Worse than midfield on inside (6L from lead). Held Ground midrace & improving Two Wide from 800m & pushed to quicken @ 600m. Pushed along Two Wide @ 400m & pressured Five Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Held ground 3 Wide in straight. # One-paced.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping was bumped by another runner which shifted inwards.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away evenly. Rolled fwd 3 Wide until raced 4th Two Wide (2.5L from lead). Out 3 Wide at times midrace & pushed to quicken @ 500m. Pushed along Four Wide @ 400m & pressured Four Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Boxed on steadily Four Wide in last 200m. # Steady effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Travelled wide and without cover for the majority of the event. Approaching the winning post, eased when hampered by another runner shifting in.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat rail 3l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 2-3l off, hit line well doing best late # best work late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Upon straightening was steadied when unable to proceed into a tight run to the inside of the leader. Approaching the 300m was then checked and shifted out across the heels of another runner to obtain clear running.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 4.5 Lengths on fence, made no ground to Turn then improved only a length along rail in straight. [Stewards: Travelled keenly early/middle stages.] # midfield throughout
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Travelled keenly in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Settled touch Worse than midfield Two Wide 5 Lengths 1000m, Ridden Along between runners soon after Straightening Up , only battled last 200m, blinkers again # battled last 200m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Travelled keenly in the early stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 5.5 Lengths 3 Wide , little change to 6 Lengths Two Wide turning, steered a couple of lanes poast centre of track Straightening Up , Made Some Ground down the outside in straight. [Stewards: Travelled keenly back straight.] # never a real threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Travelled keenly down the back straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 3rd 3 Wide 1 length. 3 Wide turn under pressure. weakened # 3 Wide trip
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early stages and travelled wide and without cover throughout. Rider was counselled by Stewards regarding her riding in the early stages and was advised that she should have made a greater effort to allow her mount to improve forward and cross the runners drawn to her inside to avoid being caught wide.
